approvalScope: Default hologram UI design across all STAM spaces, including bottom menus. Preserve layered cyan translucent glass, chamfered luminous borders, restrained gold selection, white line icons, clear typography and spatial depth. Pair with nearest-wall sliding entry and exit. The simplified motion preview is not the visual standard.
review: Left function menu and right dialogue/response choices readable; guide face and clasped hands unobstructed. Visual concept only; interaction not implemented.
prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / ui-mockup.
Edit the supplied existing photo by adding ONLY a sophisticated holographic user interface on its left and right sides. Create one photorealistic landscape 16:9 concept still at the same framing. Preserve the exact existing woman, face, expression, hair, uniform, hands, body, camera, lighting, desk, seated receptionist and entire background. No reframing, no cropping, no different person, no added characters.

Design goal: an elegant usable Star Citizen inspired welcome-desk conversation interface, two floating spatial hologram panels flanking the central Flight Guide, integrated into the scene with subtle perspective and light reflections. The guide must remain completely unobstructed from hair to clasped hands. Keep a clean central corridor roughly x34%-66%. No UI over her face, body or hands.

LEFT: compact vertically stacked function buttons contained in an airy holographic panel within x4%-29%, y26%-77%. The panel has a slightly angled side edge, visible layered glass depth, fine cyan-blue illuminated bevels, restrained warm gold selection accent matching lounge lighting, very subtle scanline texture, deep transparent teal tinted glass behind readable near-white text. The visual plane is mostly front facing; perspective is shallow so Korean words stay easy to read. Small tasteful simple line icons next to each button. A small uppercase header "STAM / WELCOME", a Korean title "무엇을 도와드릴까요?", and four generously spaced buttons, exact Korean text:
"첫 운송 시작"
"운송 절차 안내"
"함선·화물 정보"
"라운지로 돌아가기"
Make the first option gently selected, not an orange solid block. Buttons have projected layered glass depth; no giant flat opaque rectangle and no mechanical console.

RIGHT: a somewhat taller floating dialogue hologram within x70%-96%, y23%-82%, aligned with the left panel's visual language and similarly shallow perspective. Main header exact Korean "플라이트 가이드"; a small discreet "STAM · 안내 데스크" secondary line. Main greeting in clean highly legible typesetting, line-wrapped naturally with generous line-height:
"STAM에 오신 것을 환영합니다."
"첫 운송을 함께 준비해 볼까요?"
Below, a clear divider and two distinct reply-choice outlined interactive rows with exact text:
"처음이에요. 안내해 주세요."
"운송 준비부터 시작할게요."
Tiny minimal speech symbol or voice status detail allowed. No input keyboard, no technical metrics, no progress percentages, no lorem ipsum, no other text.

Make the panels appear like stable light projections hovering in the actual lounge space rather than a pasted opaque website screenshot: translucent depth layers, precise illuminated border segments, tiny luminous corner details, restrained soft cyan light reflection, modest real depth between buttons and backplate. Keep background visible through them while maintaining contrast under text. Keep visual clutter low. No excessive bloom, no bright white flares, no fog, no decorative unreadable microtext, no floor projector pedestals, no circles or interface over the character. Show a polished single proposed layout, not a before/after comparison.
